prompt: In the style of an oil painting, a sun-drenched botanical greenhouse reveals a lush interior teeming with life. On the left, a woman in a wide-brimmed straw hat stands beside a tall potted palm, her posture relaxed as she leans slightly against the terracotta pot. Next to her, a small tabby cat sits on the wooden bench, grooming its paw with meticulous care. In the center, an elderly man in a tweed vest points toward a hanging orchid, drawing the attention of a young girl in a yellow dress who looks at the delicate purple blooms with wide-eyed wonder. Beside them, a wicker basket rests on the floor, overflowing with fresh cuttings and gardening tools. To the right, a gardener in green overalls hands a trowel to a boy in a blue cap, their fingers brushing briefly during the exchange. Behind them, a large glass pane reflects the silhouette of a distant city skyline, adding depth to the verdant scene. A brown leather satchel lies open next to the wicker basket, spilling out seed packets onto the checkered tile floor. Perched on a high shelf above the group, a parrot with vibrant red feathers watches the activity below, tilting its head curiously. Near the entrance, a black umbrella leans against the wall, its fabric still damp from recent rain. The air feels thick with humidity, captured in the soft brushstrokes that define the condensation on the glass roof. There is no digital technology visible in this timeless setting. There is no artificial lighting fixture hanging from the ceiling, only natural light filtering through the leaves.
